meta.purpose: Mandate-driven e-SAF demand per hub airport: demand_year = airport fuel uplift 2024 x fuel growth factor(year) x synthetic-fuel share(jurisdiction, year). Used when sizing='mandate'.
meta.shares_source: EU: Regulation (EU) 2023/2405 (ReFuelEU Aviation) Annex I - synthetic aviation fuel minimum shares: 1.2% average 2030-2031 (0.7%/y floor), 2.0% avg 2032-2034, 5% 2035, 10% 2040, 15% 2045, 35% 2050. UK: SAF Mandate SI 2024/1187 art. 3(7) - PtL sub-obligation ~0.5% of total jet fuel in 2030, ~1.5% 2035, ~3.5% from 2040 (flat thereafter). CH: applies ReFuelEU shares at Zurich/Geneva via the Air Transport Agreement from 1 Jan 2026 (CO2 Act Art. 28f; Joint Committee decision 25 July 2025).
meta.growth_source: EASA European Aviation Environmental Report 2025 base scenario: EU27+EFTA full-flight fuel CO2 ~140 Mt in 2024 -> ~140 Mt (2030) -> ~138 Mt (2050): traffic growth (+11.5% flights to 2030, ~+40% to 2050, EUROCONTROL) largely offset by fleet/ATM efficiency (~1.5-2%/y). Base factors: 2030 = 1.02 (range 0.99-1.10), 2050 = 1.00 (range 0.80-1.15) vs 2024.
meta.reference_case_note: SAU/ARE/MAR carry no EU mandate; sizing='mandate' keeps them at the fixed reference size (export case to be analysed separately).
